# DogBar 0.1.2
## New Settings experience
- Redesigned Settings with a native macOS 26 sidebar, toolbar, glass buttons and grouped controls. - Dedicated pages for General, Permissions, Dock & Desktops, Previews, Switcher, Appearance, New Windows, Diagnostics and Beta. - Animated feature demos, clearer descriptions and search that jumps to individual settings. - DogBar appears in the Dock while Settings is open, then returns to your saved visibility preference when Settings closes.
## Agent Activity (Beta)
- Optional Claude Code and Codex session activity at the top of your screen, with a small animated dog for each session. Enable it in **Settings › Beta**; it is off by default. - Hover to see session details, grouped tool calls and the last response. Switch sessions using the dots, arrows or Command-1 through Command-9 while hovering the open island. - Attention badges distinguish sessions that need you, failed turns and unseen finished responses. Optional sounds announce important changes. - One-click hook installation, update and removal preserve other settings and create a backup. Review and trust Codex hooks with `/hooks`; start a new Claude Code session after installing or updating its hooks. - Open the app hosting a session, or send Claude Code a follow-up note after a finished turn. Notes are background hook notifications, not user-message bubbles or permission approvals. Codex does not support sending notes. - A configurable idle island, a simulated demo, scrollable responses and reduced-motion support. - Session activity is passed locally to DogBar. This includes a short prompt excerpt and the final response; the agents still use their own services.
## Fixes and improvements
- Apps launched through Spotlight and Finder appear in the Dock earlier during startup, with launch bouncing restored. - Command-Tab can be captured when recording a new shortcut. - Notification badge counts are centered using the digits' actual outlines. - Background presentation updates are deferred while native menus are open to reduce interference with hover highlighting. - Fixed a crash when focusing DogBar's own Settings window from its Dock icon by performing its window actions on the main thread. - Settings dropdowns use neutral control colours while switches retain the accent colour. - Refined Dock glass, rim, icon spacing, separators and window indicators. Spacing scales with icon size and Dock position.
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later.
## Updating
From 0.1.1, choose **Check for Updates…** once this release is published, then **Install and Relaunch**. Your settings are retained.
Version 0.1.0 and public previews through preview 5 need one manual installation because they do not contain the in-app updater: quit DogBar, replace the app in Applications, eject the disk image and reopen DogBar.

# DogBar 0.1.1
- New guided onboarding with an animated mascot, product demos and clear permission steps. - Improved first-install Screen Recording guidance, including installing into Applications and reopening after granting access. - Added signed in-app updates with Sparkle and configurable automatic update checks. - Fixed the New Window preview's hover state and matched its height to window previews. - Improved desktop identification when switching Spaces. - Paused DogBar's Dock, previews and switcher throughout onboarding, including replayed tours, to avoid overlapping Docks.
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later.
## Installing this update
DogBar 0.1.0 and public previews through preview 5 do not include Sparkle. Install 0.1.1 manually once: quit DogBar, drag the new app into Applications, replace the existing copy, eject the disk image and reopen DogBar. Later versions can update through **Check for Updates…**.
If macOS asks again for Accessibility or Screen Recording, enable DogBar and choose Quit & Reopen. Existing settings are retained.
